subject: MAP: Load test slotting & runbook ownership — proposed windows and owners
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ross <julia.ross@finsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load test slotting & runbook ownership — proposed windows and owners

Hi Julia / Michael,

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — appreciate the clarity on peak patterns and the SLO targets. Per our MAP, the next milestone is the traffic replay / peak-QPS run to validate Dedicated sizing and the replay runbook.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Option A: Tue 2025-08-05 22:00 – 23:30 PT (off-peak for FinSight)
- Option B: Wed 2025-08-06 03:00 – 04:30 PT (preferred for Redwood for infra availability)

High-level asks from FinSight for the test:
- Representative traffic trace (prefix-limited) + expected peak QPS and bucket distribution
- List of API keys and routes to include in the replay
- Stakeholder on-call during the run (name + mobile)

Redwood responsibilities:
- Provide runbook + step checklist (attached runbook draft) — owner: Marissa Cole
- Provision Dedicated pool sized to target peak + 20% buffer — owner: Dylan Brooks
- Execute replay and collect latency/cpu/gpu metrics, kv-cache hit rate — owner: Connor O'Brien

Can you confirm which window works and whether FinSight can provide the trace and on-call? If neither window works, propose two alternatives. I attached the MAP draft with the milestone dates and a runbook spreadsheet for quick edits.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment stubs: MAP_draft_FinSight_v1.pdf, loadtest_runbook_draft.xlsx, capacity_snapshot_QPS.csv
From: Julia Ross <julia.ross@finsight.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@finsight.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test slotting & runbook ownership — proposed windows and owners

Connor —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. Option A (2025-08-05 22:00 PT) looks best from our ops perspective; Option B hits a maintenance window for one of our upstreams. Confirming the following from FinSight:
- We can deliver a 30-minute representative trace (anonymized headers) by EOD Thu 2025-07-24.
- Expected peak QPS: ~1,200 sustained over 10m with 3-second 95p target. Burst to 1,800 for <1 minute in our historical traces.
- On-call during the run: Michael Lee (michael.lee@finsight.ai, +1 312-555-0166).

Couple of asks on your end before we lock the slot:
1) Can Redwood confirm the exact Dedicated GPU instance families you'll provision (we need to review for internal compliance)?
2) Will the test include long-context chat sessions (yes/no) — we want to ensure token/caching behavior is tested.

Also attaching a short internal compliance checklist (we'll send the trace via secure upload).

Julia Ross
Head of Platform Engineering | FinSight Analytics
julia.ross@finsight.ai

> On Sat, Jul 19, 2025 at 9:13 AM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — appreciate the clarity on peak patterns and the SLO targets....
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Julia Ross <julia.ross@finsight.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test slotting & runbook ownership — proposed windows and owners

Thanks Julia — confirmed Option A is fine on our side. Quick answers to your asks:
1) Provisioning plan: We'll allocate two dedicated nodes: a pair of A40-equivalent instances (multi-GPU) with nvlink enabled and the optimized kernel stack. Final SKU names will be shared once procurement commit is done — Dylan will follow up with SKUs and AMI IDs by 2025-07-23.
2) Long-context sessions: Yes — the run will include chat flows with up to 6k token contexts to validate KV caching and mem usage. We'll include a separate long-context replay file.

Ownership recap for the MAP milestone (edited into the runbook):
- Redwood runbook delivery: Marissa (deliverable by 2025-07-24)
- Dedicated sizing + SKUs: Dylan (deliverable by 2025-07-23)
- Trace ingestion & secure transfer: FinSight (deliverable by 2025-07-24)
- Test execution & observability report: Connor (execution on 2025-08-05, report by 2025-08-07)

I'll upload the updated runbook to the shared Drive link and leave inline comments on the MAP draft.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: updated_loadtest_runbook_v2.xlsx

> On Mon, Jul 21, 2025 at 8:05 AM Julia Ross <julia.ross@finsight.ai> wrote:
> > Connor — Thanks for the clear breakdown. Option A (2025-08-05 22:00 PT) looks best...
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ross <julia.ross@finsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test slotting & runbook ownership — proposed windows and owners

Julia / Michael —

Great — thanks for confirming Option A and for the QPS numbers. Action items and immediate next steps:
- Dylan: please post SKU + AMI details to the HubSpot deal and to the Drive doc by 2025-07-23.
- Marissa: upload runbook v2 and add the checklist items (alert thresholds, rollback steps) by 2025-07-24.
- FinSight (Julia/Michael): upload the anonymized trace to the secure upload link by 2025-07-24 and confirm Michael will be on-call for the run.

I'll hold the 2025-08-05 22:00 – 23:30 PT slot pending Dylan's sizing confirmation. If Dylan cannot commit that SKU by the 23rd, we will need to push the run by one business day.

Final note for the MAP: Target close date for the pilot milestone remains 2025-08-15 (engineering sign-off + capacity acceptance). I'll update the MAP milestone dates in the attached MAP_draft_FinSight_v1.pdf once the runbook updates land.

Thanks — speak soon,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

---- Forwarded attachment stubs: updated_loadtest_runbook_v2.xlsx, MAP_draft_FinSight_v1.pdf
